text:
maria: quick design question — in compact run results the schema-lint snack shows one-line errors but no way to act. feels like a missed affordance when folks land on a failing invocation.

ikram: +1. we should surface a persistent micro-cta. maybe a small pill that opens the schema editor focused on the failing field. :thumbsup:

jordan: accessibility nits: if the snack appears asynchronously we need role=alert on the summary + ensure keyboard focus lands on the pill. screen readers should hear counts (e.g. '3 schema issues').

sam: UX idea: collapse long function/args in run history and show a 1-line lint summary. clicking expands an inline diff view. keeps history compact.

maria: thinking copy: currently 'Fix schema' might imply auto changes. propose 'Review schema issues' (neutral) or 'Open schema editor'. which reads better?

ikram: prefer 'Review schema issues' — signals human review. also show small counter badge like [3] and tooltip 'r to open'. keyboard shortcut: r to open focused on first issue.

jordan: also ensure error chips have aria-describedby linking to the explanation. and color is not the only cue (we already use icons).

sam: mock incoming. i'll add a compact state and an expanded inline diff into the run row. will include a11y annotations in the mock.

maria: tiny suggestion for micro-copy in expanded diff: 'Suggested fix' vs 'Suggestion' — use 'Suggestion' when it's optional.

ikram: technical note for runtime: show a short snippet of offending json path and the failing constraint, e.g. code block: 

```
inputs[0].user_profile.age: expected integer <= 120, got string 'forty'
```

This helps debugging without opening full editor.

jordan: +1. also check focus trap when diff opens so keyboard users can escape back to the run list.

sam: will attach figma link in a follow-up thread once mock is up.

maria: action list: sam -> mock and share link by EOD Tue; ikram -> add UX props & keyboard spec; jordan -> run SR quick checklist against mock; i'll create the PR template for copy & a11y notes. tagging @a11y-bot for automated checklist reminders.

a11y-bot: reminder queued: run quick SR audit when mock link posted.

maria: thanks everyone — keeping this tight will make the compact run history way more useful for debugging tool-calls. :rocket:
